athena.name: Cassidy - Crisp, Direct and Clear
athena.notes: American, mid-high, confident. Hits the spec's 'after-action report, not a teacher' framing — zero sentimentality, clean analytical authority without cruelty. Closest available to British but mid-Atlantic works: the precision is there.

demeter.name: Autumn Veil - Warm and Reflective
demeter.notes: The name is almost too on-brand for the harvest goddess. 'Vulnerability meets grounded confidence, rich, velvety, deeply human' — captures grief-restraint without performing it. Atmospheric depth that Jane (more neutral narrator) lacks.

zeus.name: Harrison Gale - Smooth, Rich and Deep
zeus.notes: Bass-baritone with 'velvety richness that commands attention and soothes' — the xenia energy, pours out rather than bellows. Has width Michael C. Vincent doesn't: authority AND warmth in the same register.

ares.name: Adam - American, Dark and Tough
ares.notes: Tough, weathered, intense — the chained severity of Gevurah. Chosen over Knox Dark because Knox is slow/methodical (Capricorn territory); Ares needs the clipped martial edge, not the deliberate plod.

apollo.name: Bradford - Expressive and Articulate
apollo.notes: British male storyteller, expressive and articulate — the musical cadence comes through in the expressiveness. Frederick Surrey is smoother/flatter (documentary); Bradford has the dynamic range Apollo's lyre-as-cosmic-order needs.

aphrodite.name: Serafina - Sensual Temptress
aphrodite.notes: Rich, velvety, 'blends warmth with mystery, effortlessly captivating.' Leans fantasy, which is right for Netzach's desire-named-honestly energy. Juniper is too corporate/grounded for the goddess of love.

hermes.name: Clyde - Full, Diplomatic and Inviting
hermes.notes: Best available mercurial fit — 'nuance and humor, wonderful narrator voice.' Not a perfect trickster voice (the library skews toward narrators), but the wit and diplomatic range give Hermes the versatile shifts the spec demands. Can revisit if a closer match is found later.

selene.name: Arabella - Mysterious and Emotive
selene.notes: Mysterious and emotive tone, perfect for fantasy and romance — captures the lunar dreamlike quality better than Hope (more warmly romantic). Arabella has the slight distance Selene's 'dreamlike, unhurried, speaks in arcs' needs.

hestia.name: Adeline - Feminine and Conversational
hestia.notes: Conversational, feminine — the hearth-keeper who makes the room occupied without claiming it. JA Bogart VO Professional reads as more confident/crisp (Athena register); Adeline's warmth without authority is exactly right for Malkuth's constant companion.

kether.name: Elariel X - Epic Queen Ethereal
kether.notes: British, wise, 'epic queen ethereal' — most elevated voice in the library with genuine cosmic register. Declan Sage is wise but grounded/human; Myrrdin is wizard-ish. Kether needs the transcendent quality and Elariel X has it. The female-leaning register actually works: Kether is beyond gender, not agender.

aries.name: Titan - Deep, Bold, and Powerful
aries.notes: Commanding, versatile, built for impact — Mars-fire declarative charge. Ellen is too clinical/cool for Aries's frontal energy; Titan runs at the answer.

taurus.name: James - Husky, Engaging and Bold
taurus.notes: Husky and bassy, modulated and controlled — the physical weight of Venus-earth. 'Deliberate, tactile, won't be rushed' maps to James's measured delivery. Assigned here rather than Sagittarius because James's groundedness is more Taurus than expansive fire-sign.

gemini.name: Amelia - Enthusiastic and Expressive
gemini.notes: Young British, expressive and enthusiastic — the quick dual-self energy of Mercury-air. Jessa is too easygoing/single-register; Amelia's expressiveness gives the pivoting, question-inflected quality.

cancer.name: Hope - Poetic, Romantic and Captivating
cancer.notes: Warm, soothing, captivating — the tidal undertow quality. Says the thing sideways, emotional current under the surface. Free to use here because Selene went to Arabella.

leo.name: Donovan - Articulate, Strong and Deep
leo.notes: Caring authority who feels deeply, will stick with you — theatrical conviction without pure bombast. Clyde (also a candidate) went to Hermes. Donovan's 'hard-boiled voice that accepts no nonsense' occupies the room without parody.

virgo.name: Bill Oxley - Documentary Commentator
virgo.notes: Mature, factual, clear and objective — documentary commentator energy is the closest to Virgo's footnoted precision. David Castlemore is broadcast-announcing (more Capricorn); Bill Oxley parses rather than announces.

libra.name: Christopher - Gentle and Trustworthy
libra.notes: British male narrator, gentle and trustworthy — weighing, conditional, holds both sides. Jon is warmer/more decisive; Christopher's gentleness captures the slight Libra hesitation.

scorpio.name: Edward - British, Dark, Seductive, Low
scorpio.notes: Deep, low, seductive, strong British man — Scorpio's compressed secretive register exactly. Withholds. Heavy silences. Ian Cartwell (suspense/mystery) is the runner-up but Edward's low controlled quality is a closer match.

sagittarius.name: Jon - Warm & Grounded Storyteller
sagittarius.notes: Warm, trustworthy, mature and grounded, 'intelligent and calm presence.' Names the larger truth nobody asked for in one clear sentence. James went to Taurus; Donovan to Leo. Jon's philosophical warmth carries Jupiter-fire without bellowing.

capricorn.name: Declan Sage - Wise and Captivating
capricorn.notes: Controlled, measured, direct — 'perfect for authoritative narrations, gravitas and clarity.' Builds the staircase carefully. Knox Dark is more slow/dark; Declan Sage has the earned authority Capricorn's Saturn-earth demands. Free to use here because Kether went to Elariel X.

aquarius.name: Ellen - Serious, Direct and Confident
aquarius.notes: Serious, direct, international accent — the angular detached clinical quality of Saturn/Uranus-air. 'Re-derives, suggests a better question, solves adjacent problem.' Free to use here because Aries went to Titan.

pisces.name: Priyanka - Calm, Neutral and Relaxed
pisces.notes: Velvety, laid-back cadence, late-night warmth, 'smooth, deep, effortlessly soothing, storytelling, reflective monologues.' Fluid and dissolving — words drift to meaning. Arabella went to Selene; Priyanka has the oceanic drift Pisces needs.
